description: OidcError implements std::error::Error but source() only returns Some for Http(e). The other variants (Config, InvalidToken, InvalidKey, etc.) carry String payloads that lose the original error chain. Using thiserror would allow #[from] / #[source] to preserve the original cause chain automatically and is consistent with the rest of the codebase (CredentialStoreError uses thiserror). The current implementation loses the jsonwebtoken error chain behind a to_string() call in try_key.
title: auth: OidcError does not implement std::error::Error::source for non-Http variants
